caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's fingerprint sensor isn't taking a photo; it's mapping you with electricity!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Your phone uses tiny electric fields to 'see' your unique fingerprint.
🔹 It measures electrical changes when your skin touches the sensor.
🔹 This creates a detailed 3D electrical map of your ridges and valleys.
🔹 This invisible scan is why your phone unlocks instantly and securely!
